SHOW CAUSE NOTICE UNDER SECTION 73 OF THE CGST ACT 2017
Notice Ref: SCN/GJ/2023/505 Dated 05-09-2023
GSTIN: 24EEEFF3456E1Z4 M/s Sterling Chemicals
FY: 2022-23

1. It is noticed that taxpayer delayed payment of tax liability for October 2022 by 45 days. The tax paid was Rs. 6,00,000/- out of which Rs. 5,00,000/- was available in Electronic Credit Ledger and Rs. 1,00,000/- was paid in cash.
2. The officer calculated interest under Section 50 on the gross liability of Rs. 6,00,000/- amounting to Rs. 45,00,00/- instead of restricting calculation to net cash liability.
